name: Fear Not
overview: The Scriptures firmly encourage believers to 'fear not,' assuring them of God's constant presence and unwavering support. From Deuteronomy to Isaiah, God promises strength, courage, and deliverance, emphasizing that He will never fail or forsake His people. The psalmist echoes this confidence, declaring that with the Lord as their light, salvation, and comfort, there is no reason to fear any evil or adversary. This divine assurance calls Christians to trust fully in God's power and faithfulness in every circumstance.
